name: agience-server-ophan
description: Economic operations layer: the standing-energy surface (heat cooled to the current frame, flat-fee settlement), licensing and entitlement operations, and subscription state. Rates are MEASURED at the screen, never configured.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface.

tools.name: get_energy
tools.description: Read an artifact's ENERGY, realised value, and thermal state (the 2nd-law economy)

tools.name: settle_energy
tools.description: Compute the settlement split for an artifact's earned value (flat Origin fee)

tools.name: resolve_license_posture
tools.description: Resolve whether an organization is AGPL-compliant (community self-host) or needs a commercial license

tools.name: issue_license
tools.description: Create and sign a license artifact from entitlement inputs or approved policy parameters

tools.name: renew_license
tools.description: Extend, replace, or reissue an existing license artifact

tools.name: revoke_license
tools.description: Revoke a license and record the resulting compliance event

tools.name: review_installation
tools.description: Inspect installation state, activation status, and lease freshness

tools.name: record_usage_snapshot
tools.description: Ingest or reconcile aggregate licensing and metering snapshots

tools.name: run_licensing_report
tools.description: Produce entitlement, installation, renewal, or overage report cards

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: REFUSES — Stripe Checkout Session creation is an outbound write and must go through the op.pay.session organon (net.request + discharge gate). Raises; creates nothing

tools.name: create_portal_session
tools.description: REFUSES — Stripe billing-portal session creation is an outbound write and must go through the op.pay.session organon (net.request + discharge gate). Raises; creates nothing

tools.name: create_vu_topup
tools.description: REFUSES — VU top-up checkout is an outbound write and must go through the op.pay.session organon (net.request + discharge gate). Raises; creates nothing and charges nothing

tools.name: activate_subscription
tools.description: Activate a subscription after Stripe checkout. Creates artifacts and syncs limits to Core

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Update a subscription (plan change or cancellation). Syncs new limits to Core

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

ORIGIN_URI.description: Base URI of the Origin identity authority

_secrets_note: NO SECRET IS CONFIGURED BY ENVIRONMENT. `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` and `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` were
listed here as required env and are removed (2026-07-30, John: 'This needs to be handled by
proper secret handling'). A secret in a persona's environment has no owner, no grant, no
delegation and no audit on the read, and its absence is indistinguishable from 'not configured'.
The webhook signing secret resolves from a stored secret artifact under a delegation — see
entries named a backend and a shared platform API key that this server has not used since Phase C:
it addresses MANTLE_URI/ORIGIN_URI and signs its own platform JWTs from the chorus service identity.
_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
